title: 如园 Ru Yuan
subtitle: Ju Yuan, Garden of Likeness (Malone p.98) · Changchun Yuan

model.line: 16 boxes stand in this compound, 16 on blocks drawn on the plan, 0 assumed. Its halls are listed below.

questions.title: Halls in the texts with no row
CC18-02 敦素堂, CC18-03 冠霞阁, CC18-04 明漪楼 are Qianlong names (S05 j83:18b)

evidence.title: 御製如園詩
evidence.excerpt_zh: 乾隆三十五年御製如園詩　南北臨衢各築垣過來複道便如園有泉有竹清幽致曰室曰齋淳樸敦境冩中山遥古蹟（江寕藩司署中瞻園即明中山王徐逹西園之舊是園規制略倣之）石移西嶺近雲根邇方小得心懐暢景對南薰畧可論
evidence.summary: 如園 was built with a covered way across a road, taking its plan broadly from 瞻園 in the provincial treasury at 江寧 Nanjing, the old garden of 徐逹.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 如园
evidence.excerpt_zh: 鑑園西南為如園門三楹西嚮内為敦素堂堂北稍東為冠霞閣又東為明漪樓（長春園册）臣等謹案由如園山徑西行即澹懐堂之東垣門
evidence.summary: South-west of 鑑園: 如園 with a three-bay west-facing gate, 敦素堂, 冠霞閣 and 明漪樓; a hill path west reaches the east wall gate of 澹懐堂.

evidence.title: 御製 如園
evidence.excerpt_zh:
如園
如園本是肖江南今日江南肖實堪緑柳紅桃含潤澤明亭暗竇致差參背風竹色當前翠藉石波光徹底藍複道行空過咫尺熙春（園名在如園南祗隔重牆置複道過之今嵗猶初到也）隔嵗一尋探
evidence.summary: 如園 copies the south and is now its equal. Green willows, red peaches, bright pavilions and dark tunnels; a covered way leads over the road to 熙春園 on the south, across a double wall.

evidence.title: 御製 如園
evidence.date: c. 1786, inferred from the last dated heading (御製詩五集)
evidence.excerpt_zh:
如園
如園本以肖江南（金陵瞻園夲明徐逹故宅此園即肖其制為之因以名如）淑景金陵近可探甲第依然説徐逹梵宗云是號瞿曇（如来者瞿曇號）（也）可知空色非二諦慢憶豫逰駐六驂静室無言坐調御前三三即後三三
evidence.summary: Note: 如園 copies the 瞻園 at Jinling, the old mansion of 徐逹, and takes its name from 'being like' it.

evidence.title: 如园: 乾隆三十三年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆三十三年 (1768), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 曲转回廊接，精庐此处堪。于焉乐洒洒，岂必诩眈眈。既静有余趣，契真可息谈。正如春酝酿，生意万芳含。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 如园, 1768, on reading and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 如园: 乾隆三十三年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆三十三年 (1768), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh:
借问芳意阿谁含，宁外人心方寸里。而人适来书屋中，是即书屋含芳矣。足悟一本贯万殊，讵在嫣红与
姹紫。如云六艺有余润，亦可因之究厥旨。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 如园, 1768, on reading and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 敦素堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.46, under 如园; source ref 9-416
evidence.excerpt_zh: 尚䌹恶文著，恬心养素先。那称无长物，可以味遗编。树色入帘静，波光映座鲜。因之悟摛句，亦岂在华妍。
evidence.summary: Poem 敦素堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 如园.

evidence.title: 题敦素堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.48, under 如园; source ref 9-423
evidence.excerpt_zh: 朴斫书堂碧沼滨，澄波素影面前陈。故知绘事常为后，亦曰淳风在所循。情性由来耽澹泊，文章岂必藉涟沦。如云水监即民监，我却惭为倡化人。
evidence.summary: Poem 题敦素堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 如园.

evidence.title: 明漪楼
evidence.locator: v4 p.47, under 如园; source ref 9-422
evidence.excerpt_zh: 飞阁临无地，方塘印有天。翻光闪檐梠，落照彻沦涟。风月随时趣，鸢鱼契道诠。南昌如可拟，作记恧前贤。
evidence.summary: Poem 明漪楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 如园.

evidence.title: 明漪楼
evidence.locator: v4 p.51, under 如园; source ref 9-455
evidence.excerpt_zh: 层楼近碧池，阶戺漾明漪。自具文章旨，相资淡荡思。双双下凫子，个个跃鱼儿。俯仰皆天趣，还从镜里披。
evidence.summary: Poem 明漪楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 如园.

evidence.title: 敦素堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.51, under 如园; source ref 10-519
evidence.excerpt_zh: 阶基临曲沼，朴斫构书轩。冰鉴先呈映，波纨漫待翻。即看通体洁，那藉绮言烦。素固人应尚，况予司化源。
evidence.summary: Poem 敦素堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1769, filed by the editors under 如园.

evidence.title: 明漪楼
evidence.locator: v4 p.52, under 如园; source ref 10-520
evidence.excerpt_zh: 曲池冰冻未生波，借问明漪意若何。无极濂溪著图说，互为根究静居多。
evidence.summary: Poem 明漪楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1769, filed by the editors under 如园.

evidence.title: 如园: 乾隆三十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆三十五年 (1770), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 初韶时节发青阳，乘气临芳语众芳。一往何须太酣放，由来含者趣偏长。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 如园, 1770, on reading and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 如园: 乾隆三十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆三十五年 (1770), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 入夏饯春候，绿云红雨时。画图难貎矣，蜂蝶更撩之。繁景固如是，流阴肯暂遅。含芳谁则擅，书屋以无为。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 如园, 1770, on reading and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 如园: 乾隆三十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆三十五年 (1770), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 南北临衢各筑垣，过来复道便如园。有泉有竹清幽致，曰室曰斋淳朴敦。境写中山遥古迹，石移西岭近云根。迩方小得心怀畅，景对南薫略可论。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 如园, 1770, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 如园: 乾隆三十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆三十六年 (1771), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 复道行空界苑垣，过来石径即如园。东偏总以弗恒到，剏境讶成那忘言。偷度春光夏仍季，却看瀑布水犹翻。徘徊未免因生愧，何事若亭复若轩。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 如园, 1771, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 如园: 乾隆四十年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆四十年 (1775), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 岂不园中咫尺近，自春徂夏未经临。了知砌卉过红雨，且喜庭柯羃绿阴。步处假山势展画，引来活水韵调琴。如斯美景多虚掷，却笑其初结构心。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 如园, 1775. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 如园: 乾隆四十一年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆四十一年 (1776), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 如园本是肖江南，今日江南肖实堪。绿柳红桃含润泽，明亭暗窦致差参。背风竹色当前翠，藉石波光彻底蓝。复道行空过咫尺，熙春（园名在如园南，祗隔重墙置复道过之，今岁犹初到也）隔岁一寻探。
evidence.summary: Qianlong, 1776: 如园 copies the south; his note mentions the covered way over the double wall to 熙春园.

evidence.title: 如园
evidence.locator: v4 p.71, under 如园; source ref 14-732
evidence.excerpt_zh: 一如莫不如，园门西向开。有水亦清泠，有山亦崔嵬。罨窗者是柳，植盆者是梅。色色形形中，如是无言该。所以释迦老，得号曰如来。
evidence.summary: Poem 如园 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1783, filed by the editors under 如园.

evidence.title: 如园
evidence.locator: v4 p.76, under 如园; source ref 16-827
evidence.excerpt_zh: 偶为如园游，因绎如之意。金仙曰如来，无无非我事
evidence.summary: Poem 如园 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1788, filed by the editors under 如园.

evidence.title: 如园
evidence.locator: v4 p.77, under 如园; source ref 17-443
evidence.excerpt_zh: 忆昔游建康，瞻园爱其景。归来爰肖之，信如卷阿境。斯岂类新丰，彼以都城整。徒供耳目娱，吾过吾早省。吴民爱戴情，实缱心头永。
evidence.summary: Poem 如园 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1792, filed by the editors under 如园.

evidence.title: 冠霞阁
evidence.locator: v4 p.80, under 如园; source ref 1-325
evidence.excerpt_zh: 径转回廊竹密遮，摄衣登阁拂云霞。堤边缕缕柳垂线，陇首青青麦吐芽。春溥三千生庶汇，风来廿四发群葩。凭栏极目心遥系，亟愿兵销蜀岭涯。
evidence.summary: Poem 冠霞阁 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 如园.

evidence.title: 重修如园记 (Jiaqing)
evidence.date: 嘉庆十六年 (1811), per the editors
evidence.excerpt_zh: 昔我皇考南巡江宁，观民问俗之暇，临幸前明徐达瞻园。规仿其制，于长春园东南隅隙地，建屋宇数楹，命名“如园”，取义如瞻园之意也。亭台池榭，复磴层峦，天然图画，不日而成。圣制诗云：“一如莫不如”，盖纪实也。斯园建于乾隆三十二年，至今已四十余载。地近河壖，渐觉沮洳，风雨剥落，多有倾圮。岂可任其荒废，弗加修治乎？爰出内帑，命苑臣略加营葺，顿复旧时面目矣。园门西向，朴素清幽，入门不数武，即翠微亭。周环假山，萦青繚翠。东有方沼，跨以小石桥。流泉琮琤，入耳成韵。桥东有榭，额曰“听泉曲”，室曰“云萝山馆”。巡檐而南转，东则芝兰室，夫同心之言，其臭如兰。师友讲论，仅有裨于学问耳。若君明臣良，畴咨告诫，有益于苍生寰宇者，大矣。室前溪流聚成小池，缘池岸南登虚榭，额曰“锦榖洲”。风来，水面叠为绿绮。大块文章，自然佳妙也。东则层楼高峙，八窗洞开。园中诸景，一览在目，集其大成，楣额“含碧”。南俯原田，验晴雨，占丰歉，一室千里，康田在念。楼北度板桥，大石岩雄踞一园，卓立千仞。石磴盘纡，峰回路仄，登其巅，坐清瑶榭，益觉心旷神怡矣。下有洞，可四达。东有荷池，亭亭净植，清芬徐来，如挹君子。池北则延清堂，为园之正殿。规模轩敞，栋宇崇隆，四时皆宜，消寒避暑。然身居广厦，永感慈恩。若耽于晏安，不恤蓬户瓮牖之疾苦，纵欲败度，非予颜堂曰“延清”之志矣。堂前东山，由挹霞亭至观丰榭，可望园外稻畦。南则待月台，堂西有引胜斋、撷秀亭、香林精舍、可月亭，皆得其自成之妙境，不可殚述也。北有静怡斋，南下石蹬，过溪桥，又达翠微亭矣。北曰“新赏室”，南曰“搴芳书屋”。屋南幽篁数亩，挹翠浮筠。南有墙门，可达熙春园，兹不复赘。如园诸胜，一切如旧，非别有创造、大兴工作也。斯园前如瞻园之境，后如如园之规，继自今于万斯年。斯干苞茂，予有厚望焉。
evidence.summary: Jiaqing's essay on the great repair of 如园 in 1811, naming the renewed parts; the main Qing text on this garden's layout.

evidence.title: 孟夏延清堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.82, under 如园; source ref 5-137
evidence.excerpt_zh: 堂临芳渚印漪涟，候正清和永夏延。红药当阶绚旭影，绿杨垂岸罥晴烟。坡平转觉小亭迥，磴仄欣看虚榭连。摹拟瞻园如旧境，喜逢时雨润林泉。
evidence.summary: Poem 孟夏延清堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1812, filed by the editors under 如园.

evidence.title: 延清堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.83, under 如园; source ref 5-142
evidence.excerpt_zh: 旧室新营境不迁，高堂虚敞面晴川。松篁雅籁窗间送，山水清晖座右延。九仞含青石结秀，千丝蘸绿柳垂烟。云楣题额会心远，巩固金瓯亿万年。
evidence.summary: Poem 延清堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1812, filed by the editors under 如园.

evidence.title: 新正如园延清堂作
evidence.locator: v4 p.81, under 如园; source ref 5-115
evidence.excerpt_zh: 岁献新韶意总如，旧园重建有那居。清佳旭影辉层阁，和蔼春光拓远墟。令节顺时设灯彩，几闲悦性只诗书。从来寓物不留物，肯负昔年修业初。
evidence.summary: Poem 新正如园延清堂作 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1812, filed by the editors under 如园.

evidence.title: 如园: 道光五年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
evidence.date: 道光五年 (1825), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh:
春光九十正芳妍，波叠轻绡草带烟。竹坞松关云外景，鸥汀鹭屿画中天。楼标含碧文峰上，堂启延清曲沼
边（含碧楼、延清堂，如园之檐额也）。胜境几闲宜赏憩，诗情到此每成篇。
evidence.summary: Daoguang, 1825: his note names 含碧楼 and 延清堂 as plaques of 如园.

evidence.title: 如园: 咸丰六年 poem of the Xianfeng Emperor
evidence.date: 咸丰六年 (1856), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 解缆流香渚，名园景重寻。催诗荐新爽，点浪杂繁音。好雨占三日，浓烟锁一林。先期蒙泽渥，铭感为拈吟。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Xianfeng Emperor at 如园, 1856, on boating. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 如园: 咸丰六年 poem, naming 流香渚
evidence.date: 咸丰六年 (1856), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 解缆流香渚，名园景重寻。催诗荐新爽，点浪杂繁音。好雨占三日，浓烟锁一林。先期蒙泽渥，铭感为拈吟。
evidence.summary: Xianfeng, 1856: casting off from 流香渚 for 如园 in rain, so the boat route ran from there.

evidence.title: 长春园 No.6, 狮子林 Shizi Lin, and No.8, 如园 Ru Yuan
evidence.excerpt_other: The Lion Grove, Number Six, was patterned from a garden of that name in Che-kiang, and the Ju Yuan, or Garden of Likeness, Number Eight, and its pools, bamboos, rockeries, and flower beds arranged like those of the provincial treasurer's yamen in Nanking.
evidence.summary: 狮子林 after a garden of that name (Malone says Zhejiang; it is usually placed at Suzhou, in Jiangsu) and 如园 after the provincial treasurer's yamen garden in Nanjing.

evidence.title: 长春园 Changchun Yuan: eight chief groups
evidence.excerpt_other: The new garden which the Emperor constructed in 1751 just east of the Yuan Ming Yuan he called the Ch'ang Ch'un Yuan, or Garden of Long Spring.
evidence.summary: From Rixia j83. Built 1751 by Malone's date, added to for years; about a third of the size of the Yuan Ming Yuan proper; islands and artificial hills with wider spaces and larger lakes. No.1 audience hall inside the south gate (澹怀堂); No.2 palace on the central island (含经堂); Nos.3, 6, 8 lakeside gardens; Nos.4, 5, 7 palace groups on islands. Mapping of numbers to ids is mine; only 6 and 8 are named by Malone.

evidence.title: 长春园: the one building not on the compass grid
evidence.excerpt_other: The only building of any description in the whole Yuan Ming Yuan group which was not built square with the cardinal points of the compass was a small pavilion which faced northeastward upon a little bay surrounded by hills a hundred yards north of the Ju Yuan, Number Eight.
evidence.summary: A small pavilion facing north-east on a little bay, 100 yards north of 如园. Which hall is not named.

evidence.title: Site status table, about 2011: scattered remains only
evidence.summary: Scenes with only scattered, incomplete building remains in the same table. 方壶胜境 is listed separately as the one with fairly complete remains not yet tidied up. 紫碧山房, 舍卫城 and 如园 have been dug since.

evidence.title: List of the excavated sites of the Yuanmingyuan, 1994-2024 (贾贯峰, 圆明园研究 83)
evidence.locator: section on the site museum, para. starting 圆明园是我国第一批国家考古遗址公园
evidence.summary: Since the first formal digs at 藻园 and 十三所 in 1994, the important sites excavated are 含经堂, 澹怀堂, 大宫门, 养雀笼, 谐奇趣, 海晏堂, 远瀛观, 桃花洞, 如园, 紫碧山房, 舍卫城 and 澹泊宁静 (written just as the 2024 文源阁 dig ended). The site museum is to centre on 正觉寺, with a planned museum at 大宫门.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 如园
evidence.summary: The early poems (1768-1770, and again 1788) call it 含芳书屋; 如园 appears from 1770. The 1776 poem says it copies the south and notes a covered way over a double wall to 熙春园 on the south. A note of 1825 names 含碧楼 and 延清堂. Daoguang brought the dowager here for meals, 1829-1840; the last entry is Xianfeng rowing here in rain, 1856. 如园: 24 dated items, 1768-1856, of which 16 poems and 8 court records (Qianlong, Jiaqing, Daoguang, Xianfeng); recurring themes: the view, visits to the dowager, reading. First dated 1768, last dated 1856.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 如园
evidence.summary: Finished 1767 in the south-east corner, after 瞻园 in Nanjing, linked to 熙春园 by a bridge over the street. Halls included 含芳书屋, 敦素堂, 明漪楼. Heavily repaired in 1811, when Jiaqing's essay 重修如园记 gives the layout and nearly all plaques were changed; he also named ten scenes.

evidence.title: 如园 dig findings as reported in 如园延清堂建筑复原研究
evidence.summary: Floor bricks of 延清堂 reddened and cracked through, and paths and hills reddened, point to a long fire, which the author links to 1860. A patterned tile floor survives in the west end bay of the second row. Tile finds were grey; seven scraps of yellow and blue glaze are unexplained.

evidence.title: 如园 and 紫碧山房, 北京 2017 archaeology news, 新京报 via 中新网
evidence.summary: 如园 gave over a thousand objects, among them a stone with a Jiaqing inscription, 金砖 floor bricks, famille-rose tiles, jade and gourd moulds, and fixed the places of several of the 如园十景 ten views.

evidence.title: 揭秘圆明园考古, 华西都市报 via 中证网
evidence.locator: news, 张中华 and 张利芳
evidence.summary: Three large campaigns since 1996 yielded over 50,000 finds. The campaign from 2012 dug 桃花洞, 大宫门, 养雀笼, the 海晏堂 water tower and 远瀛观. At 如园 Ru Yuan, the best-preserved of these sites and the first imitation of a Jiangnan garden dug here (19,000 m2 site, 2,800 m2 buildings, 3,800 m2 opened), diggers found 芝兰室, 云萝山馆, 听泉榭, 延清堂, 含碧楼, 挹霞亭, 观丰榭, 引胜轩, rockery, paths and shores, and burnt famille-rose floor tiles in 延清堂.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
